Retrieve the corporate group structure (konsernstruktur)

Source: R/konsern.R
brreg_konsern.Rd

Fetch the registered group hierarchy for a Norwegian legal entity from the Enhetsregisteret konsernstruktur endpoint (added by BRREG 2026-06-24). The tree is returned flat: one row per node, root included at level = 0, each child carrying its link form (knytningsform, e.g. KDAT "Konsern datter"), ownership basis (grunnlag, e.g. "100%"), and the registration date of the relation.

Usage

brreg_konsern(org_nr)

Arguments

org_nr

Character. 9-digit organization number.

Value

A tibble with one row per node in the group tree. Columns: org_nr (the queried entity), node_org_nr, node_name, level (0 for the root), link_form, link_form_desc, basis, relation_date (Date), parent_org_nr, parent_name, legal_form, legal_form_desc. Returns an empty tibble if no group structure is registered.

Details

The JSON response omits knytningsform on the root node while the API's CSV variant emits it as KKKK "Øverste mor"; the root row is synthesized here to match the CSV semantics.

This is the ownership hierarchy and is distinct from brreg_children(), which searches overordnetEnhet — the administrative parent relation used in public-sector (ORGL) structures, not konsern ownership.

404 semantics

The endpoint returns 404 both for organization numbers that do not exist and for live entities that are not part of any registered group — the common case for ordinary companies. A warning is issued and an empty tibble returned; the in_corporate_group column from brreg_entity() disambiguates the two without a second lookup here.

See also

brreg_children() for the ORGL administrative hierarchy, brreg_entity() for the in_corporate_group flag, brreg_roles_legal() for roles an entity holds in others.

Other tidybrreg entity functions: brreg_board_summary(), brreg_children(), brreg_download(), brreg_entity(), brreg_prokura(), brreg_roles(), brreg_roles_legal(), brreg_search(), brreg_signatur(), brreg_underenheter(), brreg_update_fields(), brreg_updates()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive() && curl::has_internet()
brreg_konsern("923609016") # Equinor ASA
}
